## [s-rune-owner] Local visible-rune owner

Layer: Situation.

For each visible rune, the owner is the nearest observed living teammate, including self, who is on home land, unhooked, not rotting and at least 40-percent HP. Break equal distances by player ID. Cooldown does not transfer ownership; an owner already hooking retains its claim. This ownership is local to the observation, not hidden global state. The override requires another visible living teammate and a rune within 36 tiles on each axis of self.

Provenance: E05, v14-rune-003, 2026-09-15. Refine rune priority after the uncoordinated E04 screen; reuse the formation collector eligibility with a currently visible rune as destination. Jointly dependent with E06.

Evidence: Untested. Predict only one early rune claimant when allies share the same visible state. Hidden allies can cause disagreement; no perfect coordination claim.
